update.releaseNotes:
v5.9.41 - Mandatory race locking + settings crash hardening
Additions --- - Smart Race Solver now locks each character's forced career-objective races onto their turn (from GameTora's URA objectives data), so it never double-books a conflicting race; choice turns (e.g. Oaks vs Derby) pick the best-aptitude option - Parent farming goal queue now loops back to the start instead of repeating the last preset once a multi-run session outlasts the queue
Fixes --- - Settings reads that could throw on an empty/invalid stored value (template-match thresholds, stat-priority list) now fall back safely instead of crashing on startup
